english:
Scoring 8 Machine Gun hits, or 2 Rocket Launcher hits within 7 seconds, grants <pve 25% /> <pvp [5%] /> Damage Resistance (Resist x2) for 10.5 seconds and 100% additional Base Grenade and Melee Ability Regeneration Rate for 10 seconds.

Killing an <link Elite Tier or higher [#CombatantClassifications] /> Combatant while the buff is active disorients Rank-and-File Combatants within 10 meters for 6 seconds.

source.text:
Upon scoring 8 Machine Gun damage instances, or 2 Rocket Launcher damage instances within 7 seconds of each:
25% [5%] Damage Resist (Resist x2) for 10.5 seconds
100% Additional Base Grenade and Melee Ability Regeneration Rate for 10 seconds.

While Heavy Ordnance is active:
Elite+ Combatants Kills disorient Rank-and-File Combatants within 10 meters for 6 seconds.
